subject: CAIQ assertion harmonization + packaged evidence for EU residency review
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <ciso@latticehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@latticehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Dec 2025 17:18:00 +0000
Subject: Request: CAIQ assertions + residency evidence for upcoming vendor review

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. Our security review team has asked for a consolidated CAIQ response package scoped to Lattice Health (SaaS tenant in EU) so we can validate control assertions and the underlying artifacts before our audit window next month.

What we need from Redwood:
- Completed CAIQ spreadsheet (control-level answers, narrative for any partial/no answers)
- Evidence index (owner, link, brief description, sample timeframe)
- Explicit artifacts proving EU data residency for customer workloads (tenant diagram, tenancy isolation notes, region-level backups)
- Crypto/KMS key rotation statement and sample audit log for a rotation event

Can you confirm an ETA and whether you can provide vault links or a packaged ZIP for the evidence? We prefer short-lived links (expires in 7 days) and redacted samples where necessary.

I've attached the initial CSA scope spreadsheet we sent to procurement — it has the controls we care about.

Marta Ruiz
CISO | Lattice Health
--
Attachment: initial_csa_scope.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 48 KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <ciso@latticehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Dec 2025 18:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ assertions + residency evidence for upcoming vendor review

Marta —

Appreciate the clear list. We can get a consolidated CAIQ deliverable together with a scoped evidence package. Proposed plan:

1) Deliverables (T+7 business days):
   - CAIQ CSV with per-control answer + narrative + pointer to evidence index (CSV)
   - Evidence bundle exported as short-lived Vault links + Drive manifest; we will mark any PII/PHI as redacted and include sampling windows
   - Tenant residency diagram (EU regions called out) and backup/replication notes
   - KMS rotation event sample and attestation statement (signed by Security Ops)

2) Owners: Kimberly will produce the evidence index and map owners for each control; Marissa will coordinate procurement/licensing items and any requested NDAs/addenda for audit access.

3) Risk notes: A few controls rely on tenant-scoped telemetry we can sample; for those we'll provide anonymized log slices and a replay transcript of the rotation event.

I'll attach a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft so we can align milestones. If that looks good, Kim and I will start harvesting the artifacts and we can provide short-lived vault links as they are ready.

ETA: target 7 business days from today (Dec 10 EOD UTC) unless you have a tighter window.

Jordan Blake
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
Office: +1 415-555-0134
--
Attachment: MAP_draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 22 KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <ciso@latticehealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Dec 2025 09:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ assertions + residency evidence for upcoming vendor review

Hi Marta / Jordan —

Quick technical note on scope and what we'll surface in the evidence index:

- Control mapping: I'll provide a control-level owner column (platform, security-ops, infra, legal) and a column for evidence type (diagram, log sample, policy, attestation). That will make it easy to spot gaps.
- Residency: We'll include an architecture diagram (tenant isolation) and the S3 bucket + DB region residency statements. Where backups cross regions for DR, we'll provide an explicit copy lifecycle note and retention configuration.
- Telemetry/logs: Will supply 2 examples: (a) tenant-specific request/response trace showing EU region routing, and (b) a KV-cache eviction/replication excerpt to prove storage locality. Logs will be redacted and timeboxed to the sampling window you specify.
- KMS rotation: you will get a signed attestation and a .log sample describing the rotation operation (key id masked).

Timing: Jordan's T+7 business days is realistic for a first-pass package. If you need on-site audit access to deeper logs we can provision scoped access after an NDA addendum.

I'll assemble an evidence_index.csv that lists the artifact filename, owner contact, short description, link type (vault/drive), and sample timeframe.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: evidence_index.csv (text/csv, 3 KB)

From: Marta Ruiz <ciso@latticehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@latticehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Dec 2025 15:42:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ assertions + residency evidence for upcoming vendor review

Thanks — that plan works for us. A couple of small asks before you package:

- Can you ensure Vault links expire after 7 days and that the Drive manifest is read-only access?
- Please include the sampling window in the evidence_index.csv (we'd prefer 2025-10-01 through 2025-11-30)
- We need an NDA audit addendum signed before any scoped access to raw telemetry. Procurement will follow up with a DocuSign link; Marissa, please confirm whether Redwood requires a revenue-impact addendum for evidence extraction.

If you can deliver the first-pass set by Dec 10 EOD UTC that gives our security reviewers a week to triage before the audit kickoff.

Appreciate the responsiveness — looking forward to the packet.

Marta
